title: Compliance gate simulator and cutover schedule for tenant onboarding
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Objective: Build a reproducible 'compliance gate simulator' that computes pass/fail for a tenant onboarding cutover and produce a guarded cutover schedule for SSO + audit-log retention migrations. Scope: - Simulation engine that models evidence collection (SSO assertions, SAML metadata validation, audit-log retention policies per region) and calculates a readiness score by tenant. - Schedule generator that produces phased cutover windows (canary, regional ramp, full) with automated guardrails and rollback triggers. - Instrumentation: integrate with existing Compliance Dashboard + Grafana to display per-tenant readiness, gating signals, and predicted time-to-pass. - Deliverables: simulator microservice, config UI in Console that exports cutover windows, runbook for oncall and customer success. Rationale: Recent enterprise trials show 25% of onboarding failures are due to misaligned SSO metadata / retention policy mismatches. A simulator lets us validate configurations before the actual cutover and reduces rollback risk. Acceptance criteria (top-level): - Simulator computes readiness score with >90% fidelity versus manual audit on a sample of 50 tenants. - Cutover plans include explicit canary %, monitoring hooks and automatic hold if gating signals cross thresholds. - Console exposes downloadable cutover plan and one-click pause/abort for CS/oncall. - Post-cutover incidents decreased by 60% for tested tenants across next two quarters. Stakeholders: - PM: Sofia Martinez (owner) - Eng: Asha Patel (implementing lead), Jeremy Li (infra), Maria Gomez (security review) - CS: Priya Rao (cutover ops) - Legal/Privacy: Daniel Kim (data residency mapping) Timeline & phases: - Week 1: Prototype simulator with schema-driven validators and sample tenant data. - Week 2: Integrate SSO metadata checks + retention policy matcher. - Week 3: Hook simulation output to Console export and generate cutover schedule. - Week 4: Canary run with 3 internal tenants and runbook dry-run. - Week 5: Security review and signed off by Legal - Week 6: Pilot with first customer. Rollout plan: 1) Internal canary (3 tenants, 10% traffic) 2) Low-risk external pilot (1 customer, <50 users) 3) Regional ramp (EU -> NA -> APAC) 4) Full rollout. Gating signals and thresholds: - SSO assertion success rate >99.5% over 10 minutes - Audit-log ingestion lag < 30s for retention-critical events - KV cache hit rate for tenant config >95% - No open high-severity security findings. If any signal trips, automatic hold and alert to CS/oncall. Post-launch: schedule 2-week burning window with daily syncs and an incident retro. Links to artifacts, dashboards, and runbooks in attachments. Next steps: unblock infra quotas (ENG-45122), complete security checklist, and book pilot customer time with CS.
